SOOOooooo, I accidentally found out that I can use Henna Gold to slowly and subtly shampoo in highlights. Wonderful products - helping me to transition from many years as a blond to my natural color. Brings out highlights to help blend the old and new. Leaves hair shiny and soft.

reviews.t: This shampoo works with brown hair
reviews.x: This is my favorite shampoo and I have been using it every summer for the past few years. Keep in mind it's always better for your hair to experience different products, otherwise I would use it year-round. I get compliments on the natural golden highlights that this shampoo brings out of my dark brown hair without fail each year.

reviews.t: Been using this brand & combo for years!

reviews.t: Wow, this accentuates my natural highlights!
reviews.x: I seriously love this shampoo &  conditioner and I love the fact they are cruelty free.  They make my hair shiny which brings out my natural highlights & even helps hide the gray!  I’d say it probably makes my hair a bit lighter overall, but maybe that’s just what my highlights naturally do when they are “pumped up” a bit!  I’ll buy this again & probably try other hair products from this brand.

There is no scent and the conditioner doesn't indue all my tangles but they seem like good quality products.  Unfortunately there was an advertisement on the bottle that you could get a free bottle if you went to the website but this was not true.

reviews.t: that's okay because it's been great for my scalp

I tried this because it contains henna, and I'm very pleased with the results. I kind of wish the conditioner was a little bit heavier, as the shampoo cleans very thoroughly and leaves my hair a little too poofy.

This product did exactly what I hoped it would do to my rather drab looking hair. I now having a lovely golden look and my hair is softer, feels even thicker and looks so much healthier! My once auburn hair has returned and I'm extremely happy!

reviews.t: love the shine/highlights it gives my light brown hair

reviews.t: This is great shampoo and conditioner

reviews.t: Shampoo is great but not the conditioner

claims.text: Many reviewers say the shampoo and conditioner leave hair shiny and bring out natural highlights.
Several reviewers report their hair feels soft and silky after use.
Some reviewers note the product can dry out hair or add too much body, making coarse hair puffy.
Reviewers frequently praise the scent, describing it as pleasant or a soft herbal fragrance.
A few reviewers mention shipping or packaging problems, such as a leaked conditioner bottle or unwanted promotional wrapping.
